# netbox_ike_policy (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/vpn/ikepolicy/):

> An IKE policy bundles IKE proposals with the version and mode of the first phase of an IPsec negotiation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_ike_policy" "example" {
  name = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the ike policy.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the ike policy.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the ike policy.
- `mode` (String) One of [aggressive, main].
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the ike policy. Needs NetBox 4.5.0 or later.
- `preshared_key` (String) The preshared key of the ike policy.
- `proposal_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the proposal associated with the ike policy.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `version` (Number) One of [1, 2].

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) When the ike policy was created.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_updated` (String) When the ike policy was last changed.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_ike_policy.example 1
```
